mods.name: Create: Pocket Sized
mods.description:
Experimental alpha: back up worlds before testing.
Create-flavoured spatial compression and contraption logistics for Sable sublevels, built on Pym.
Shrink and enlarge vehicles and structures, pocket the miniature directly,
recover wrecks, weld crafts of different sizes together with the Hot Glue Gun, and fire unprotected
pocketed contraptions with Create machinery.

releases.notes: ## REQUIREMENTS - Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required. - Pym 0.5.0 is my scaling library currently bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed. - Client and server must both be on 0.24.0. ## Pym v0.5 ### Collision & LOD Optimizations - All entities now use LOD colliders for sublevels (based on relative scale) to prevent lag. - Very large or complex scaled colliders fall back safely instead of failing to build. - Large entities use a faster water check. - Scaled sublevels skip water checks in chunks with no water. - Simulated Coaster optimizations for tiny rollercoasters. - Pym's scaling no longer affects 1x sublevels & players. ### Physics - Split sublevels inherit their original scale, and both halves continue resizing if split during a resize. - Splitting a sublevel while it's resizing no longer freezes the 2 halves. - Breaking blocks too quickly no longer causes scaled sublevels to suddenly pop back to 1x. - Disassembling scaled crafts grows them back to 1x, so they shouldn't clip into the world anymore. - Disassembly uses the same clipping-protection ground clearance as normal growing. - Mass is re-synced during resizing, so firing planes out of the Potato Cannon should no longer make them explode. - Sublevels fired out of the Potato Cannon should be much more stable. - Tiny crafts have a much lower minimum weight. - Scaled sublevels now have proper ice physics, stickyness, bouncyness, and similar block properties. Conveyor belts don't work yet. - Water physics and buoyancy should be much more accurate and stable. - Propellers keep their full thrust according to scale. - Magnets and docking connectors are scale-aware. - Springs can now connect sublevels of different sizes too. - The contraption diagram now works on scaled crafts. ### Players & Entities - Shrinking while standing near the edge of a sublevel tries to keep you on by pushing the player a bit. - Giant players can lift more with handles, while tiny players lift less. - Player handle offsets now scale properly with player size. - Punch forces now scale with player size. - Arrows now push crafts according to their size. - Create's Schematic tools reach and draw at your scale. ### Mod Compatibility - Transmission & Linkage universal joints and hydraulics now use scaled lengths, and render at the smaller scale of the 2 connected crafts. - Transmission & Linkage rod lengths, rendering, and collision are adjusted for the scales of both connected sublevels. - Wheel suspension now works properly on cars over 2x scale. Before, the suspension couldn't detect extend far enough. Suspension on slopes is improved. - Wheel suspension extension now scales properly on enlarged crafts. - Aeroworks gyroscopes no longer break upon relogging, but might be underpowered on smaller sublevels. - Experimental Trackwork and Tracks support. ## Pocket Sized v0.24 ### Scaling Tools - Compression guns now use Alt to toggle grow/shrink instead of Shift + Scroll. They only use durability when out of Levitite Blend, and now have 60 durability. - Personal Subspace Compressor no longer has durability, so it can be refueled when empty instead of breaking. - PSC has a new keybind (unbound by default) that works from your hotbar or belt slot. Hold Shift with it for the scale menu. - Compression guns/PSC can now use the Capacity enchantment. Each lvl of Capacity adds 1/3rd more Levitite Blend storage to the tank (can change in configs). - Sitting in a tiny seat now sets your PSC's target scale to that seat for convenience. - The Portable Subspace Compressor now resizes everything joined to its craft along with it. ### Pocket Knife Polish ...

releases.notes: > _New animated banner!_ ## REQUIREMENTS - Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required. - Pym 0.4.2 is bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed. - Client and server must both be on 0.23.0-preview1. ## SCALING TOOLS - Compression guns now use Alt to toggle grow/shrink instead of Shift + Scroll. They only use durability when out of Levitite Blend, and now have 60 durability. - Personal Subspace Compressor no longer has durability, so it can be refueled when empty instead of breaking. - PSC has a new keybind (unbound by default) and optional Curios belt support. - You can pick a scale outside your PSC or Creative Shrinkray's normal range if something nearby is already at that scale, so you can match it. - Sitting in a tiny seat now sets your PSC's scale to that seat, so using it will resize you. ## PLAYERS & SCALING - You don't need to hold Ctrl to ride a resizing sublevel anymore. Everyone standing on it rides along unless they have PVP Scaling protection on. - Players sitting in seats always resize with their craft. - Giant players can lift more with handles, while tiny players lift less. - Punch forces now scale with player size. ## PHYSICS & LINKS - Flexible Shafts have no physics impulses or springyness, so they can connect crafts of different scales. - Flexible Shafts and Couplings are weightless, and snap when stretched past 1.5x their length. - Springs can now connect sublevels of different sizes too. - Scaled sublevels now have proper ice physics, stickyness, bouncyness, and similar block properties. - Water physics and buoyancy should be much more accurate and stable. - Propellers now keep their full thrust according to scale. - Magnets and docking connectors are scale-aware. - The contraption diagram now works on scaled crafts. - Blueprint Casing is less sticky (was 4, now 1.65, same as soul sand), and its encased variants keep that stickyness. ## COMPATIBILITY - Transmission & Linkage universal joints and hydraulics now use scaled lengths, and render at the smaller scale of the 2 connected crafts. Rod hitboxes scale properly too. - Optional Curios support for the Personal Subspace Compressor's belt slot. - Wheel suspension now works properly on cars over 2x scale. Previously the suspension couldn't detect extend far enough. ## POLISH & MISC - The Create: Pocket Sized creative tab has a new hand-crafted animated banner! - Levitite Blend buckets are now in the Pocket creative tab. - Hot Glue has its own whitish grey slime textures and particles. - Empty Boxes now stack to 16. - Display Bottles, Display Cases, and Display Plates no longer stack. - Scale menu preview has dirt under the grass now. - New config option to let creative players pocket sublevels of any size. ## FIXES - Copycat Façade renamed to Copycat Facade, without the diacritic. - Creative Worldshaper no longer drops the block used on a Copycat Facade. - Fixed a texture seam on the Pocket Knife. I still plan to overhaul its model. - Sublevels fired out of the Potato Cannon should be much more stable. - Disassembling scaled crafts grows them back to 1x, so they shouldn't clip into the world anymore. - Breaking blocks too quickly no longer causes scaled sublevels to suddenly pop back to 1x. - Splitting a sublevel while it's resizing no longer freezes the two halves. ## PYM & PHYSICS - Scaled sublevel hitboxes now match exactly what Sable builds at 1x. - Split sublevels inherit their original scale, and both halves continue resizing if split during a resize. - Mass is re-synced during resizing, so firing planes out of the Potato Cannon should no longer make them explode. - Tiny crafts have a much lower minimum mass instead of being forced to weigh at least 0.25kg. - Player handle offsets now scale properly with player size. ...

releases.notes:
Create: Pocket Sized Alpha v0.22.0 w/ Pym 0.4.1

REQUIREMENTS
- Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required.
- Pym 0.4.1 is bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed.
- Client and server must both be on 0.22.0.

COMMANDS
- /pocket sethandscale <scale> sets the held Creative Shrinkray or Personal Subspace Compressor scale, takes 0.0625 or 1/16

FLEXIBLE SHAFT
- It just carries shaft rpm, no physics impulses/springyness
- Snaps if stretched too far like a spring though
- Can connect sublevels of different sizes, visual tapers between them which is subject to change but looks fine for alpha purposes
- Flexible Coupling is now 'weightless' with Aeronautics tagging

PYM
- Physics Assembler grows small crafts back to 1x with the same clipping-protection ground clearance as normal growing, so they don't clip into the ground when disassembling
- Step-up finally follows the sublevel's block size
- All scales of players stand up and change pose properly under low ceilings on scaled sublevels
- Fixed near-plane clipping getting doubly scaled with Pehkui
- Physics Staff hold distance follows the larger scale between player &sublevel
- Block breaking particles on scaled crafts reworked, more to come on this.
- Fixed a crash caused by loading a scaled craft with no mass

MISC
- Blueprint Casing has more friction
- Brass Display Plate is now visible via the creative tab
- Compression Cannon & Personal Subspace Compressor use up their levitite blend internally first, and only then try to use durability
- Punchy compat
- a few more tiny fixes.

SAVE GAMES
- Back up your world before updating please.
- Resized sublevels keep their scale when you update.

KNOWN ISSUES
- Collision can still lag when a large entity stands on a much smaller sublevel
- Pressure plates and similar blocks on 1/32 crafts don't react to 1x players. This is as an attempt to fix the lag mentioned previously...
- Scaled Contraptions (native Create ones, like the Mechanical Bearing) have no collision.

releases.notes:
Create: Pocket Sized Alpha v0.21.0 w/ Pym 0.4.0

NEW REQUIREMENTS
- Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required.
- Pym 0.4.0 is bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed.
- Client and server must both be on 0.21.0.

LICENSE
- Pocket & Pym code is now under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. Assets stay All Rights Reserved. See LICENSE.md

NEW
- Blueprint Casing (replaces Blueprint Tile). New Omni texture, encased shafts, cogwheels, and large cogwheels with it.
- Flexible Shaft and Flexible Coupling (WIP)
- Magnifying Glass (WIP)

PYM
- Springs can't connect blocks of different sizes because rn they explode often
- Transmission & Linkage hydraulics and universal joints now scale and taper between different sized crafts
- Faster entity lookups around scaled sublevels
- Experimental Simurail support, off by default
- New links API so other mods can make connected sublevels scale together

PONDERS
- Highly experimental new ponder ability to scale a sublevel inside a ponder
- For now, just a basic test on the Creative Shrinkray, please report any issues with viewing this before I proceed with making more comprehensive in-game docs using Ponders.

SCALING TOOLS
- Hold Ctrl while firing the Compression Cannon or Creative Shrinkray to rescale only the target, not its neighbours
- L-Click a target with the Personal Subspace Compressor or Creative Shrinkray to pick its scale
- Portable Subspace Compressor now has a Resize Protection lock
- Creative Shrinkray entity targeting fix which was causing crashes with absurdly small sublevels nearby

HOT GLUE
- Aim at a block's far edge to help glue faces hard to pick otherwise
- Welded crafts now scale around the weld pivot

MISC
- Pocketed case tooltips now show size at scale and entity count
- Schematic and Quill works on sublevels
- Punchy compat
- Fixed weld lines getting thick when zoomed in
- a bunch more tiny fixes.

CONFIGS
- resizeEntitiesOnCrafts moved to Pym as resizeEntitiesWithSublevels (default true).
- New Pym option: experimental.simurailSupport (default false).

SAVE GAMES
- Back up your world before updating please.
- Resized sublevels keep their scale when you update.
- Blueprint Tiles become Blueprint Casings when you update.

KNOWN ISSUES
- Collision can still lag when a large entity stands on a much smaller sublevel
- Pressure plates and similar blocks on 1/32 crafts don't react to 1x players. This is as an attempt to fix the lag mentioned previously...
- Scaled Contraptions (native Create ones, like the Mechanical Bearing) have no collision.
